SOP-VERIFY-01.title: Verify camera and tracking evidence
reactive: Verify that the selected camera image is current and readable.
Check for obstruction, camera movement or a changed field of view.
Review another available camera view when the current assessment remains unavailable.
proactive: Monitor whether tracking support recovers for a sustained interval.
Keep the designated supervisor informed if reliable assessment cannot be restored.
escalation: Follow the venue-approved escalation procedure if reliable observation remains unavailable.
recovery: Confirm that usable evidence has returned; restored tracking alone does not establish crowd safety.

SOP-VISIBILITY-01.title: Respond to degraded camera visibility
reactive: Inspect the live image for smoke, spray, glare or physical obstruction.
Treat count and flow conclusions from this view as unreliable.
proactive: Monitor visibility and prepare a maintenance or supervisor escalation if it persists.
escalation: Use only the venue-approved communication chain; do not infer an evacuation route from this alert.
recovery: Close only after visibility and evidence quality remain usable for the configured recovery interval.

SOP-CAMERA-01.title: Verify suspected camera movement
reactive: Check whether the camera moved, zoomed or changed scene.
Suspend motion-based conclusions until the view stabilizes.
Re-establish the analysis reference after stabilization.
proactive: Record the affected interval so it is excluded from model evaluation.
escalation: Escalate persistent camera instability through the approved technical-support process.
recovery: Resume interpretation only after a stable reference has been established.

SOP-CROWD-01.title: Verify unusual collective movement
reactive: Review the highlighted zone and supporting camera evidence.
Confirm the observation using another available source or an authorized observer.
Record whether the movement is crowd-driven, camera-driven or inconclusive.
proactive: Continue monitoring direction changes, visibility and tracking reliability.
Prepare the venue-approved escalation path if verified conditions worsen.
escalation: Only an authorized operator may initiate physical crowd-control actions or public announcements.
recovery: Resolve after authorized verification and a sustained return to the venue-defined normal condition.
